documentation_source: LPU Campus Sustainability & Green Audit Reports (Public Domain)
zero_fabrication_disclaimer: This document registers publicly acknowledged campus water management systems as contextual engineering infrastructure. Exact underground pipe geometry is NOT inferred or fabricated.

stormwater_drainage_systems.description: Concrete lined roadside saucer drains and catch basins along main campus ring roads and NH-44 frontage, designed to convey sheet runoff to retention swales.
stormwater_drainage_systems.design_standard: Indian Road Congress (IRC:SP:42) Guidelines for Urban Highway Drainage

stormwater_drainage_systems.description: Documented network of rainwater harvesting recharge pits and injection wells located at designated green quadrangles to facilitate groundwater recharge.
Interconnected surface channels and vegetated retention basins conveying excess runoff towards western low-lying buffers near Chaheru stream.

sanitary_sewage_systems_strict_separatio.warning: STRICT HYDROMETRIC SEPARATION ENFORCED: Campus wastewater, sewage lines, and Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) pipelines are NOT classified as stormwater drainage. They carry domestic effluent and do not receive storm runoff directly.
sanitary_sewage_systems_strict_separatio.treatment_capacity_documented: On-campus modular Sewage Treatment Plants (STP) utilizing MBBR/SBR technology for domestic recycling (flushing/horticulture).
